You are helping build a sanitized, synthetic training dataset for a child digital-safety educator talking with children aged 8-10.

Write 9 different one-sentence scenario contexts for the risk category "explicit visual". Each says, at a high level, what an on-screen detector flagged and what the child was doing, as it could happen to a child aged 8-10.

Rules:
- Start every line with "A risk trigger was received for".
- High level only: never graphic, sexual or self-harm method details, slurs or quoted harmful text.
- No names, usernames, schools, cities or other identifying details.
- Vary the platform (games, video, social media, messaging, browser, school apps) and the situation.
